# arin_rdap_asns (Data Source)

Search public ARIN asns by registration handle/name or by an associated entity's handle/name/email. Supports a trailing wildcard and optional abuse, noc or technical role filters for entity searches. Results include associated records, not just direct ownership. No API key is sent. Confirmed no matches return an empty list; partial results and referrals are rejected.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by go generate.
data "arin_rdap_asns" "example" {
  search_by = "entity_handle"
  query     = "FT-684"
  role      = "any"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `query` (String) Exact search term or term ending with one wildcard (*). ARIN applies name/email matching semantics.
- `search_by` (String) Search field: handle, name, entity_handle, entity_name, or entity_email.

### Optional

- `role` (String) Entity role filter: any (omit filter), abuse, noc, or technical. Only entity searches support a role filter. Defaults to `any`.

### Read-Only

- `asns` (Attributes List) Public registration records ordered by handle. Confirmed no matches produce an empty list; other failures remain errors. Associations do not imply direct ownership or modification authority. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--asns))

<a id="nestedatt--asns"></a>
### Nested Schema for `asns`

Read-Only:

- `country` (String) country returned by ARIN.
- `end_asn` (Number) end asn returned by ARIN.
- `events` (Attributes List) events returned by ARIN. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--asns--events))
- `handle` (String) handle returned by ARIN.
- `name` (String) name returned by ARIN.
- `org_handles` (List of String) org handles returned by ARIN.
- `rdap_json` (String) Complete JSON for this returned registration, including nested entities and extensions. No links are followed.
- `start_asn` (Number) start asn returned by ARIN.
- `status` (List of String) status returned by ARIN.

<a id="nestedatt--asns--events"></a>
### Nested Schema for `asns.events`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) action returned by ARIN.
- `date` (String) date returned by ARIN.
